narrative: Argues that intention is not alien to physics but an emergent property of complex self-maintaining systems, from biological organisms to artificial networks, and presses toward the hypothesis that the universe as a whole may be the kind of system whose dynamics favor — not merely permit — the arising of caring, goal-directed structures. Draws on Deacon, Kauffman, Nagel, Marder, and Teilhard de Chardin to build a graduated, naturalistic account of cosmic teleology.
